128105: A struggling university student living in Tokyo. He studies at Nerima University. Kazuya possesses a wishy-washy nature and is susceptible to yielding to his selfish desires. His lies often get him into trouble, because he cannot muster the strength to tell the truth.
128106: Chizuru Ichinose, alternatively known as Chizuru Mizuhara in her "rental girlfriend" persona, is a college student at Nerima University who is majoring in Literature and she currently lives in Room 204 of Royal Hills Nerima, just next to Kazuya Kinoshita.
144665: Sumi is a college student who works as a rental girlfriend for the Diamond app. She's extremely shy which initially made the job quite difficult for her, but she started to improve after spending time with Kazuya.
147005: Ruka Sarashina suffers from arrhythmia and seeks a lover that will help her cope with her condition. She's seen as being a very pushy and possessive kind of person. This personality of hers developed after learning of her condition and being alienated from her peers.
153703: A streamer otaku who moved to the flat next to Kazuya and happens to go to the same college as him. Calls Kazuya "Master."
154224: She is a freshman at Nerima University and the ex-girlfriend of Kazuya Kinoshita.
172022: Kazuya's childhood friend from elementary school. He often cares for Kazuya.
